core_obligations: First proof: rewrite monomorphismness as \Delta : X \to X \times_Y X being an isomorphism, note each \Delta_i : X_i \to Y_i \times_Y (X \times_Y X) is an isomorphism and is the base change of \Delta, that {Y_i \times_Y (X \times_Y X) \to X \times_Y X} is an fpqc covering, and descend via lemma-descending-property-isomorphism (proof lines 2176-2197).

Second proof, reduction: show it suffices to prove V \times_Y X \to V is a monomorphism for a surjective \'etale chart V \to Y, via the displayed cartesian-square injectivity lemma (c surjective and a injective imply d injective); then refine the covering so that the Y_i are schemes as well (cited refinement lemma) (proof lines 2199-2216).

Second proof, conclusion: for a, b : T \to X with f \circ a = f \circ b, the base changes a_i = b_i over each Y_i, so the compositions Y_i \times_Y T \to T \to X agree; since {Y_i \times_Y T \to T} is an fpqc covering, a = b by the fpqc sheaf proposition (proof lines 2218-2233).
proof_roadmap: Descend the isomorphism property of the diagonal along the fpqc covering.
Independently reduce to schemes by an \'etale chart and a sheaf injectivity argument.
Conclude equality of morphisms from agreement over an fpqc covering using the sheaf property.
difficulty_reason: The author gives two complete, independent arguments. First proof: f is a monomorphism iff its diagonal \Delta is an isomorphism; each base-changed diagonal \Delta_i is an isomorphism and is the base change of \Delta; the fpqc covering pulls back to an fpqc covering of X \times_Y X; descent of the isomorphism property (cited) makes \Delta an isomorphism. Second proof: reduce to Y a scheme via a surjective \'etale chart, using a sheaf-theoretic injectivity lemma for the cartesian square with c surjective; refine the covering so the Y_i are schemes too; then for a, b : T \to X with f \circ a = f \circ b, the base changes agree (f_i monomorphism) over the fpqc covering {Y_i \times_Y T \to T}, and the fpqc sheaf proposition (cited) gives a = b. Two full arguments with a sheaf-level lemma inside are the substance.
